unlit.name: unlit
unlit.note: the UNLIT floor east of the window light, by the wall between the two window bands: indirect only (L ≈ 30) — the GI tile

lightEdge.name: lightEdge
lightEdge.note: the lamp pool's soft east EDGE crossing dark floor (direct penumbra under pan — a control for 'edges are stable')

unlitAisle.name: unlitAisle
unlitAisle.note: the unlit floor further east along the wall, south of the second cubicle block

stripe.name: stripe
stripe.note: INSIDE the street lamp's shadow of the east mullion (x = 16.67 at the glass): a 12-cm dark stripe on the lit floor, ~10 px across

moonStripe.name: moonStripe
moonStripe.note: inside the MOON's shadow of the same mullion: lamp-lit, moon-dark (dim, wide)

litFloor.name: litFloor
litFloor.note: CONTROL: fully lit floor west of Sam (direct-dominated)

sillWall.name: sillWall
sillWall.note: the south wall's inner face BELOW the window (faces north: the lamp cannot reach it) — lit by the floor pool's bounce: the GI-dominated tile
